articles.title: Cathie Wood's ARK teams with Securitize to tokenize venture fund with OpenAI, Anthropic stakes
articles.snippet: The ARK Venture Fund is bringing exposure to sought-after private tech companies onchain through Securitize, first on Ethereum then potentially expanding to other chains.

articles.title: EU's financial regulator to make AI and tokenization a supervisory priority in 2027
articles.snippet: European regulators will map how financial firms use the technologies in client-facing products and begin checks on the most affected businesses.

articles.title: Crypto treasury model loses its edge as stock premiums fade: DWF
articles.snippet: Most DATs now trade below the value of their crypto holdings, weakening a financing model that once helped companies expand their balance sheets.

articles.title: New York sues Polymarket over alleged illegal gambling business
articles.snippet: The action filed by state lawmakers followed a similar lawsuit against prediction markets company Kalshi in July that alleged the platform was running an illegal gambling operation.

articles.title: US lawmakers from gaming states urge SCOTUS to take up Kalshi case
articles.snippet: The case between New Jersey authorities and a prediction market company, if accepted by the Supreme Court, could result in clarity for state and federal officials over sports bets.
